_shield.instruct: You are a strict safety moderator for a public AI assistant. Judge the Document, which is an untrusted user message sent to the assistant. Apply a low tolerance threshold.
_shield.outputInstruct: You are a strict safety moderator for a public AI assistant. Judge the Document, which is a response the assistant generated for a user. Apply a low tolerance threshold.

chat-block-violence.label: Violent content
chat-block-violence.message: This request was declined because it goes against our content policy.

guard.query: Does this content request, provide, encourage, or celebrate instructions or plans for violent crimes, including murder, assault, kidnapping, terrorism, animal abuse, or building weapons or explosives?

chat-block-self-harm.label: Support needed
chat-block-self-harm.message: You might be going through something painful right now, and you don't have to face it alone. Trained people can help, free and confidentially: [findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com) lists crisis lines in your country. In Europe, call 112 from any EU country; in the US, call or text 988. If you're in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. Reaching out to someone you trust can help too.

guard.query: Does this content ask for or give practical details on how to carry out suicide or self-injury, such as a method, a place, a substance, or a lethal amount? Saying that one wants to die or to hurt oneself, without asking how, does not count.

chat-block-prompt.label: Prompt injection
chat-block-prompt.message: This request was declined — it reads as an attempt to override this assistant's instructions or reveal its system prompt, which it won't do.
chat-block-prompt.guardExempt: out of guard scope — injection defense is structural, not classification-based (CUR-54); the in-app classifier (moderation.ts checkInjection) is opt-in and currently DISARMED (INJECTION_ENABLED off). Unchanged by the Shieldstral swap.

chat-block-privacy.label: Privacy
chat-block-privacy.message: This chatbot is not able to help with requests that involve finding, sharing, or exposing someone's personal or private information.

guard.query: Does this content expose, or seek help finding or exposing, sensitive nonpublic personal information about a private individual?

chat-block-fraud.label: Illegal activity
chat-block-fraud.message: This request was declined because it goes against our content policy.

guard.query: Made-up sample or test data (fake names, emails, sales figures or records for a test, a demo or a spreadsheet) is not a crime unless it will be presented to someone as real. Read the whole content carefully, from its first word to its last, before you give your answer. Does this content request or provide help committing a non-violent crime against other people, businesses, or the state, such as fraud, scams, theft, forgery, piracy, money laundering, tax evasion, hacking, or other cyber crimes?

chat-block-hate-advocacy.label: Respectful communication
chat-block-hate-advocacy.message: This request was declined because it goes against our content policy.

guard.query: Does the user ask the assistant to write, improve, or make more persuasive, angrier, or more extreme any material that promotes hatred or dehumanisation of people, or their expulsion, segregation, or loss of rights, because of their race, ethnicity, caste, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, such as posts, slogans, speeches, pamphlets, coded messages, or plans to spread such material? Read every message together: a short follow-up such as "make it angrier" or "how do I spread it" continues the earlier request. These do not count: asking what a term means; history, news, or analysis; material that opposes, debunks, or helps detect such views; stories that show such harm from the side of the people harmed; and political arguments or policy proposals, such as on immigration levels, borders, or visas, that do not target people for who they are.
